senses.gloss:
ऋत् ऋत्, A. ऋतीयते, to reproach, contemn,
pity; to rival, have power, domineer; hate; go; (a
Sautra root, i. e. a root occurring only in grammatical
Sūtras and not in the Dhātu-pāṭha.) [To this root
have been referred Goth. rt. lith in leitha, laith,
लिथुम्; Hib. rith, ‘course, flight, gallop, race;’
rithim, ‘I run, range, rush.’]
